summary: For a non-special URL with an empty path such as m://, after_first_slash is one byte beyond the serialization length. Both pop_if_empty() and pop() previously sliced from that out-of-bounds position and panicked. The fix adds early returns before slicing when after_first_slash is at or beyond the serialization length. The fix-added test pop_if_empty_in_bounds in url/tests/unit.rs exercises both methods. Reversing both guards should make it panic on pop_if_empty(); no tests were executed in this planning job.
expected_failure: byte index 5 is out of bounds of `m://`
